g.text: Giving the humanoid's joint state more tokens in GR00T N1.6

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Mean success over three manipulation tasks in simulation. 11 or 15 tokens add about 6 points with no new parameters; 3 to 9 tokens stay near the baseline.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: ALLEX humanoid, 48 joint values; tasks: cube into box, cube stacking, cylinder into tube, each at 3 object offsets × 70 episodes × 3 evaluation runs. Action horizon 16.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Whiskers: ±1 SD over 3 random grouping seeds (3-15 tokens). 1 and 48 tokens are single configurations (48 shown hollow: not yet repeated).
